description: `cli job create --cron EXPR`: cron is not supported; details.suggestedSpec is a daily schedule spec and suggestedArgv reads it with `--spec-file - --preview`. (JSON envelope)

problem.action: Create a schedule job from a JSON spec on standard input (replace your-program with your program's slug; `cli program list` lists them), previewing it first: `printf '%s\n' '{"interval_seconds":86400,"program_ref":"your-program","type":"schedule"}' | prose --output json cli job create --spec-file - --preview`.

details.reason: unknown option --cron for `cli job create`; cron expressions are not supported; a schedule job runs every interval_seconds seconds (3600 = hourly, 86400 = daily), set in the --spec-file JSON object
